```{r extract SOM signatures}
                    "Joensson_Melanoma Normal like subtype",
                    "TCGA_melanoma_keratin_high", "Harbst_melanoma_lowgrade_up",
```

```{r select signatures from SOM}
# Initialize a list to store converted genes
selected_genes_converted <- list()

# Loop through the selected signatures
for (signature_name in selected_signatures) {
  # Extract Ensembl gene IDs
  genes <- opossom.genesets[[signature_name]]$Genes
  selected_genes_converted[[signature_name]] <- genes
  }

# Initialize list to store converted gene symbols
selected_genes_converted_symbols <- list()

# Loop through the selected signatures and convert to gene symbols
for (signature_name in selected_signatures) {
  # Extract the Ensembl gene IDs
  genes <- selected_genes_converted[[signature_name]]
  print(length(genes))
  converted_genes <- ensembldb::select(EnsDb.Hsapiens.v79, 
                                       keys= genes, 
                                       keytype = "GENEID", 
                                       columns = c("SYMBOL","GENEID"))$SYMBOL
  selected_genes_converted_symbols[[signature_name]] <- converted_genes 
  }
  
# Check the structure of the converted genes
```

```{r read the rawcount}
# Define a function to replace only the first three dots with hyphens
replace_first_three_dots <- function(name) {
  # Split the name by dots
  parts <- unlist(strsplit(name, "\\."))
  new_name <- paste(paste(parts[1:4], collapse = "-"), paste(parts[5:length(parts)], collapse = "."), sep = ".")
  return(new_name)
  }

colnames(PCAI_merged_raw) <- sapply(colnames(PCAI_merged_raw), replace_first_three_dots)

colnames(PCAII_merged_raw) <- sapply(colnames(PCAII_merged_raw), replace_first_three_dots)

head(PCAII_merged_raw)
```

```{r}
  mutate(Batch_str = case_when(
```

```{r, fig.height = 5, fig.width= 12}
# 3. Prepare annotation

  "N" = "steelblue",  # orange
  "P" = "darkgreen",      # teal
  "MIS" = "pink",    # sky blue
  "RGP" = "orange", # yellow

)

rownames(annotation_col) <- colnames(mat)  # must match colnames of mat

pheatmap(
  mat,
  scale = "row",
  show_colnames = FALSE,
  cellheight = 20,
  cellwidth = 1,
  treeheight_row = 15,
  treeheight_col = 25,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "red"))(100),
  annotation_col = annotation_col,
  annotation_colors = list(histopathology_comb = hist_colors),
  fontsize = 18, fontsize_row = 16, fontsize_col = 16,
  legend = TRUE, annotation_legend = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
custom_colors <- c(
  "N" = "skyblue",  # orange
  "MIS" = "hotpink1",    # sky blue
  "P" = "darkgreen",      # teal
  "RGP" = "gold", # yellow

)


# Define base text size
base_font_size <- 14

library(scales)  # for label_number

# Plot AOInucleiCount
p1 <- ggplot(merged_df, aes(x = histopathology, y = GeneSet_1, fill = histopathology)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(color = "grey", size = 1.2, alpha = 0.8, width = 0.1) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_number(scale = 1e-3, suffix = "k")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  #labs(title = "AOInucleiCount by Histopathology", x = "Histopathology", y = "AOInucleiCount") +
  theme_classic(base_size = base_font_size) +
  theme(
```

```{r}
# ensure factor order
merged_df2$histopathology <- factor(
  merged_df2$histopathology,
  levels = c("N", "MIS", "P", "RGP", "VGP")
)

# colors
custom_colors <- c("N"="skyblue","MIS"="hotpink1","P"="darkgreen","RGP"="gold","VGP"="brown3")

genesets <- c("GeneSet_1","GeneSet_2","GeneSet_3","GeneSet_4", "ID1")

# open pdf
pdf("GeneSets_boxplots_stats.pdf", width = 7, height = 6)

for (gs in genesets) {
  
  # ---- Global Kruskal–Wallis ----
  kruskal <- kruskal_test(as.formula(paste(gs, "~ histopathology")), data = merged_df2)
  print(kruskal)
  
  # ---- Post-hoc pairwise Wilcoxon (if global is significant) ----
  pw_res <- merged_df2 %>%
    pairwise_wilcox_test(as.formula(paste(gs, "~ histopathology")),
                         paired = FALSE,
                         p.adjust.method = "BH") %>%     # adjust for multiple testing
    add_significance("p.adj") %>%
    add_xy_position(x = "histopathology", data = merged_df2, step.increase = 0.5)
  
  # ---- Boxplot with jitter + adjusted p-values ----
  p <- ggplot(merged_df2, aes(x = histopathology, y = .data[[gs]], fill = histopathology)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, color = "black") +
    geom_jitter(color = "grey", size = 1.2, alpha = 0.8, width = 0.1) +
    #scale_y_continuous(labels = label_number(scale = 1e-3, suffix = "k")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    labs(x = "Histopathology", y = gs, title = paste(gs, "Kruskal p =", signif(kruskal$p, 3))) +
    stat_pvalue_manual(
      pw_res,
      label = "p.adj.signif",  # shows stars based on adjusted p
      tip.length = 0.01,
      hide.ns = TRUE,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    )
  
  print(p)
}

dev.off()
# dev.off()
```

# now extract pc1 and pc2 loadings
```{r}
rv <- rowVars(assay(tumor_vsd))

ntop = 500 #by default

# select the ntop genes by variance
select <- order(rv, decreasing=TRUE)[seq_len(min(ntop, length(rv)))]

# perform a PCA on the data in assay(x) for the selected genes
pca <- prcomp(t(assay(tumor_vsd)[select,]))

# the contribution to the total variance for each component
percentVar <- pca$sdev^2 / sum( pca$sdev^2 )
```

```{r}
# Extract loadings (rotation matrix)
loadings <- as.data.frame(pca$rotation)

# Add gene names
loadings$gene <- rownames(loadings)

# Sort by PC1 loadings
sorted_pc1 <- loadings[order(loadings$PC1, decreasing = TRUE), c("gene", "PC1")]
PC1_top_60 <- head(sorted_pc1$gene, 60)
PC1_bottom_60 <- tail(sorted_pc1$gene, 60)

# Sort by PC2 loadings
sorted_pc2 <- loadings[order(loadings$PC2, decreasing = TRUE), c("gene", "PC2")]
PC2_top_60 <- head(sorted_pc2$gene, 60)
PC2_bottom_60 <- tail(sorted_pc2$gene, 60)
```

```{r, fig.height= 10, fig.width= 10}
# Packages
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(grid)

# ----- 1) Prep data: grab only the signature columns -----
sig_cols <- names(combined_sig)
sig_mat  <- as.matrix(tumor_sig_merged[, sig_cols, drop = FALSE])

# ----- 2) Correlation matrix (Pearson) -----
cor_mat <- cor(sig_mat, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson")

# ----- 3) P-values for each pair + BH adjust -----
n <- ncol(sig_mat)
pmat <- matrix(NA_real_, n, n, dimnames = list(sig_cols, sig_cols))

for (i in seq_len(n)) {
  for (j in i:n) {
    if (i == j) {
      pmat[i, j] <- 0
    } else {
      ct <- suppressWarnings(
        cor.test(sig_mat[, i], sig_mat[, j], method = "pearson",
                 use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
      )
      p <- ct$p.value
      pmat[i, j] <- p
      pmat[j, i] <- p
    }
  }
}

# Adjust only the upper triangle (excluding diagonal), then reflect
upper_idx <- upper.tri(pmat, diag = FALSE)
padj_vec  <- p.adjust(pmat[upper_idx], method = "BH")
padj_mat  <- matrix(NA_real_, n, n, dimnames = list(sig_cols, sig_cols))
padj_mat[upper_idx] <- padj_vec
padj_mat <- t(padj_mat)
padj_mat[upper_idx] <- padj_vec
diag(padj_mat) <- 0

# ----- 4) Significance symbols -----
sym_mat <- matrix("", n, n, dimnames = list(sig_cols, sig_cols))
sym_mat[padj_mat < 0.05]  <- "*"
sym_mat[padj_mat < 0.01]  <- "**"
sym_mat[padj_mat < 0.001] <- "***"
diag(sym_mat) <- ""  # no marks on diagonal

# ----- 5) Heatmap color scale -----
col_fun <- colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")))(200)

# Optional: set breaks to center at 0 and span [-1, 1]
# (ComplexHeatmap handles continuous values; palette above works well directly.)
# You can also cap extreme values if needed:
# cor_display <- pmax(pmin(cor_mat, 1), -1)

# ----- 6) Draw + save high-res vector PDF -----
#pdf("signature_correlation_heatmap_sundamage.pdf", width = 10, height = 10, useDingbats = FALSE)

ht <- Heatmap(
  cor_mat,
  name = "Correlation",
  col = col_fun,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  show_row_dend = TRUE,
  show_column_dend = TRUE,
  row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8),
  column_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8)#,
  # Add significance marks and (optionally) a border for padj < 0.05
  #cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill) {
    # Draw border for significant cells
  #  if (!is.na(padj_mat[i, j]) && padj_mat[i, j] < 0.05 && i != j) {
   #   grid.rect(x = x, y = y, width = w, height = h,
    #            gp = gpar(lwd = 0.8, col = "black", fill = NA))
  #  }
    # Add *, **, *** labels
   # if (sym_mat[i, j] != "") {
    #  grid.text(sym_mat[i, j], x = x, y = y,
     #           gp = gpar(fontsize = 8, col = "black"))
    #}
  #}
)

draw(ht)
#dev.off()

# ----- 7) (Optional) Save the matrices for record/reuse -----
#write.csv(cor_mat,  "signature_correlation_matrix.csv",  row.names = TRUE)
#write.csv(padj_mat, "signature_corr_padj_matrix.csv",    row.names = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------
# Libraries
# ---------------------------
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)

# ---------------------------
# Settings
# ---------------------------
uv_dn <- "HALLMARK_UV_RESPONSE_DN"
uv_up <- "HALLMARK_UV_RESPONSE_UP"

targets <- c(
  "HALLMARK_INTERFERON_GAMMA_RESPONSE",
  "HALLMARK_INTERFERON_ALPHA_RESPONSE",
  "Landsberg_dedifferentiation_up",
  "Landsberg_dedifferentiation_down",
  "Rambow.HYPERdiff(15)",
  "HALLMARK_EPITHELIAL_MESENCHYMAL_TRANSITION", 
  "Tirosh_Genes in the MITF program", 
  "Rambow.HYPERdiff(15)", "Tirosh.MITF(100)", "Tirosh.AXL(100)", "Wouters.MES.like(2115)", "Tsoi.NEURAL.CREST.like(66)"
  
)

cols_per_row   <- 4
rows_per_page  <- 2
plots_per_page <- cols_per_row * rows_per_page

# ---------------------------
# Function to make scatterplot
# ---------------------------
make_scatter <- function(data, xcol, ycol, method = c("spearman","pearson")) {
  method <- match.arg(method)
  dat <- data[, c(xcol, ycol)]
  dat <- dat[stats::complete.cases(dat), , drop = FALSE]

  if (nrow(dat) < 3 || length(unique(dat[[xcol]])) < 2 || length(unique(dat[[ycol]])) < 2) {
    return(
      ggplot() + theme_void() +
        ggtitle(paste(ycol, "vs", xcol), subtitle = "Insufficient variation for fit")
    )
  }

  ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(dat[[xcol]], dat[[ycol]],
                                  method = method, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
  r  <- unname(ct$estimate); p <- ct$p.value
  lab <- sprintf("%s r = %.2f, p = %.2g (n=%d)", method, r, p, nrow(dat))

  ggplot(dat, aes(x = .data[[xcol]], y = .data[[ycol]])) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.6) +
    labs(title = paste0(ycol, " vs ", xcol), x = xcol, y = ycol, subtitle = lab) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 4, face = "bold"),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 4),
          axis.text = element_text(size = 4),
          plot.margin = margin(4,4,4,4))
}

# ---------------------------
# Run correlations
# ---------------------------
plots <- list()
stats_list <- list()

for (uv in c(uv_dn, uv_up)) {
  for (tg in targets) {
    p <- make_scatter(tumor_sig_merged, uv, tg, method = "spearman")
    plots <- append(plots, list(p))

    dat <- tumor_sig_merged[, c(uv, tg)]
    dat <- dat[complete.cases(dat), , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(dat) >= 3) {
      ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(dat[[uv]], dat[[tg]],
                                      method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
      stats_list <- append(stats_list, list(
        data.frame(
          UV = uv, target = tg,
          rho = unname(ct$estimate), p = ct$p.value,
          n = nrow(dat)
        )
      ))
    }
  }
}

# ---------------------------
# Arrange plots into grid PDF
# ---------------------------
n_pages <- ceiling(length(plots) / plots_per_page)

pdf("uv_scatter_grid_new.pdf", width = 12, height = 6, useDingbats = FALSE)
for (pg in seq_len(n_pages)) {
  i1 <- (pg - 1) * plots_per_page + 1
  i2 <- min(pg * plots_per_page, length(plots))
  page_plots <- plots[i1:i2]

  if (length(page_plots) < plots_per_page) {
    page_plots <- c(
      page_plots,
      rep(list(patchwork::plot_spacer()), plots_per_page - length(page_plots))
    )
  }

  print(wrap_plots(page_plots, ncol = cols_per_row, byrow = TRUE))
}
dev.off()

# ---------------------------
# Save stats with BH adjust
# ---------------------------
stats_df <- do.call(rbind, stats_list)
stats_df$padj <- p.adjust(stats_df$p, method = "BH")
write.csv(stats_df, "uv_scatter_stats.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("Wrote:\n - uv_scatter_grid.pdf (multi-page, 4 plots per row, 2 rows per page)\n - uv_scatter_stats.csv\n")
```

```{r}
# --- 1) Recode and subset to N, P, MIS, Invasive (RGP+VGP) ---
graphDF_sub <- graphDF %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    hist_group = case_when(
      histopathology_comb %in% c("RGP", "VGP") ~ "Invasive",
      histopathology_comb %in% c("N", "P", "MIS") ~ as.character(histopathology_comb),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(hist_group))

# --- 1) Recode and subset to N, P, MIS, Invasive (RGP+VGP) ---
graphDF_sub <- graphDF %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    hist_group = case_when(
      histopathology_comb %in% c("RGP", "VGP") ~ "Invasive",
      histopathology_comb %in% c("N", "P", "MIS") ~ as.character(histopathology_comb),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(hist_group))

# keep case order consistent
graphDF_sub$case <- factor(graphDF_sub$case, levels = unique(graphDF_sub$case))

# --- 2) Plot function (no per-group reordering) ---
plot_uv_by_case <- function(df, uv_col, group_label) {
  ggplot(df %>% dplyr::filter(hist_group == group_label),
         aes(x = case, y = !!ensym(uv_col))) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill = NA, color = "black") +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 1.8, alpha = 0.7) +
    labs(x = paste0("Case (", group_label, ")"),
         y = as_label(ensym(uv_col))) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
}

groups <- c("N", "P", "MIS", "Invasive")

# DN
p_dn_list <- lapply(groups, function(g) plot_uv_by_case(graphDF_sub, HALLMARK_UV_RESPONSE_DN, g))
names(p_dn_list) <- paste0("DN_", groups)

# UP
p_up_list <- lapply(groups, function(g) plot_uv_by_case(graphDF_sub, HALLMARK_UV_RESPONSE_UP, g))
names(p_up_list) <- paste0("UP_", groups)
```

```{r}
# --- 0) (Optional but recommended) normalize join keys ---
stage_cases <- all_sundamage %>%
  mutate(case = trimws(as.character(case)))
graph_cases <- graphDF_sub %>%
  mutate(case = trimws(as.character(case)))

# --- 1) See which cases don't match ---
anti_join(graph_cases %>% distinct(case), stage_cases %>% distinct(case), by = "case")
anti_join(stage_cases %>% distinct(case), graph_cases %>% distinct(case), by = "case")

# --- 2) Merge ---
graphDF_merged <- graph_cases %>%
  left_join(stage_cases %>% dplyr::select(case, solar_elastosis), by = "case")

# --- 3) Replace post-merge NA with "Not available" and factor with fixed levels ---
graphDF_merged <- graphDF_merged %>%
  mutate(
    solar_group = case_when(
      is.na(solar_elastosis) ~ "Not available",
      TRUE ~ as.character(solar_elastosis)
    ),
    solar_group = factor(solar_group, levels = c("0","0.5","1","1.5","2","Not available"))
  )

# palette (grey for NA)
solar_palette <- c(
  "0" = "#1f77b4",
  "0.5" = "#2ca02c",
  "1" = "#ff7f0e",
  "1.5" = "#9467bd",
  "2" = "#d62728",
  "Not available" = "grey60"
)

# --- plotting helper (consistent case order, color & fill by solar_group) ---
plot_uv_by_case <- function(df, uv_col, group_label) {
  ggplot(df %>% dplyr::filter(hist_group == group_label),
         aes(x = factor(case, levels = unique(graphDF_sub$case)),
             y = !!rlang::ensym(uv_col),
             color = solar_group, fill = solar_group)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.15) +         # faint fill for boxes
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 1.8, alpha = 0.8) +      # colored dots
    scale_color_manual(values = solar_palette, drop = FALSE, na.translate = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = solar_palette, drop = FALSE, na.translate = FALSE) +
    labs(x = paste0("Case (", group_label, ")"),
         y = rlang::as_label(rlang::ensym(uv_col)),
         color = "Solar elastosis", fill = "Solar elastosis") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
}

p_up_list <- lapply(groups, function(g) plot_uv_by_case(graphDF_merged, HALLMARK_UV_RESPONSE_UP, g))
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ComplexHeatmap)

# ----------------------------
# 0) Data & required columns

df <- graphDF_merged

req <- c("case","slide.name","histopathology_comb","slide_roi",
         "solar_elastosis",
         "HALLMARK_UV_RESPONSE_DN","HALLMARK_UV_RESPONSE_UP")
stopifnot(all(req %in% names(df)))

# ----------------------------
# 1) Ordering
# ----------------------------
# Stage order inside each case
stage_levels <- c("N","P","MIS","RGP","VGP")
df$histopathology_comb <- factor(df$histopathology_comb, levels = stage_levels)

# Case order by solar_elastosis (1 value per case)
case_order <- df %>%
  distinct(case, solar_elastosis) %>%
  arrange(solar_elastosis) %>%
  pull(case)

df$case <- factor(df$case, levels = case_order)

# Final column order: case, then stage, then slide_roi
df_ordered <- df %>% arrange(case, histopathology_comb, slide_roi)

# ----------------------------
# 2) Build a 1xN dummy matrix (we only want annotations)
# ----------------------------
n <- nrow(df_ordered)
mat <- matrix(0, nrow = 1, ncol = n)
colnames(mat) <- df_ordered$slide_roi

# ----------------------------
# 3) Colors

hist_colors <- c(

# Solar group (categorical): use solar_group if present; otherwise bin solar_elastosis
if ("solar_group" %in% names(df_ordered)) {
  # ensure factor with stable order
  if (!is.factor(df_ordered$solar_group))

} else {

  bins <- cut(df_ordered$solar_elastosis,

  )
)
```

```{r}
#library(seriation)
#library(ComplexHeatmap)
#library(circlize)

# Scale matrix row-wise
mat_scaled <- t(scale(t(mat)))

# Reference signature for global direction
ref_sig <- "Landsberg_dedifferentiation_up"
ref_scores <- mat_scaled[ref_sig, ]

# Bin into 3 groups: low, medium, high expression
bins <- cut(ref_scores, breaks = quantile(ref_scores, probs = c(0, 0.33, 0.66, 1)), include.lowest = TRUE)
names(bins) <- colnames(mat_scaled)

# Create empty vector to collect ordered column names
final_col_order <- c()

# For each bin, apply OLO locally
for (group in levels(bins)) {
  group_cols <- names(bins)[bins == group]
  group_mat <- mat_scaled[, group_cols, drop = FALSE]
  
  # OLO on manhattan distance
  dists <- dist(t(group_mat), method = "manhattan")
  ser <- seriate(dists, method = "OLO")
  local_order <- get_order(ser)
  
  final_col_order <- c(final_col_order, group_cols[local_order])
}

# Subset matrix and annotations
mat_final <- mat_scaled[, final_col_order]
annotation_final <- annotation_col[final_col_order, , drop = FALSE]
```

```{r, fig.height= 8, fig.width= 20}
pdf("Merged_PCA_lineage_pathway_ordered_heatmap_narrow_05282025.pdf", width = 20, height = 8, useDingbats = FALSE)


high_dediff_vgp <- colnames(mat_final)[
  annotation_final$histopathology_comb == "VGP" &
  mat_final["Landsberg_dedifferentiation_up", ] > 1  # or another threshold
]

# Step 1: Get optimal OLO order
col_dists <- dist(t(mat_final), method = "manhattan")
ser <- seriate(col_dists, method = "OLO")
optimal_order <- colnames(mat_final)[get_order(ser)]

# Step 2: Split the current optimal order
vgp_late <- optimal_order[optimal_order %in% high_dediff_vgp]
non_vgp <- setdiff(optimal_order, vgp_late)

# Step 3: Custom order: bring late VGPs to the front
custom_order <- c(rev(vgp_late), non_vgp)

# Step 4: Apply new order
mat_reordered <- mat_final[, custom_order]
annotation_reordered <- annotation_final[custom_order, , drop = FALSE]

annotation_reordered

# Step 5: HeatmapAnnotation
ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  df = annotation_reordered,
  col = list(histopathology_comb = hist_colors),
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 14),
  annotation_legend_param = list(
    histopathology_comb = list(title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 14), labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12))
  )
)

  ),
  heatmap_legend_side = "right",
  annotation_legend_side = "right",
  padding = unit(c(10, 10, 10, 10), "mm")  # top, right, bottom, **left**
)
```

```{r}
library(ggpubr)
library(scales)

# Function to get significant comparisons for a feature
get_comparisons <- function(df, feature_col) {
  # Run pairwise Wilcoxon
  pvals <- compare_means(
    reformulate("histopathology_label", response = feature_col),
    data = df,
    method = "wilcox.test"
  )

  # Ensure columns exist before filtering
  pvals_sig <- pvals %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      p < 0.05
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      group1 %in% levels(df$histopathology_label),
      group2 %in% levels(df$histopathology_label)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(group1, group2) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(across(everything(), as.character)) %>%
    split(seq(nrow(.))) %>%
    lapply(unlist, use.names = FALSE)

  return(pvals_sig)
}

# Loop through each pathway
for (feature in selected_pathways) {

  # Get significant comparisons
  comparisons_sig <- get_comparisons(new_mergedDF, feature)

  # Construct the plot
  p <- ggplot(new_mergedDF, aes_string(x = "histopathology_label", y = feature, fill = "histopathology_comb")) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(color = "grey", size = 1.2, alpha = 0.8, width = 0.1) +
     scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
    labs(title = paste0(feature, " by Histopathology"), x = "Histopathology", y = feature) +
    theme_classic(base_size = base_font_size) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      axis.text = element_text(size = base_font_size),
      axis.title = element_text(size = base_font_size + 1),
      plot.title = element_text(size = base_font_size + 2, hjust = 0.5)
    )

  # Add significance if applicable
  if (length(comparisons_sig) > 0) {
    p <- p + stat_compare_means(
      method = "wilcox.test",
      comparisons = comparisons_sig,
      label = "p.format",
      size = 4,
      step.increase = 0.1
    )
  }

  # Output PDF file with pathway name
  #pdf_filename <- paste0(gsub("Stem", "_", feature), "_by_histopathology.pdf")
  #ggsave(pdf_filename, plot = p, width = 8, height = 8)
  svg_filename <- paste0(gsub("Stem", "_", feature), "_by_histopathology.svg")
  print(svg_filename)
  ggsave(svg_filename, plot = p, width = 8, height = 8)
}
```

```{r histopathology }
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)  # adds p-values to lmer models
library(broom.mixed)

# Function to run pairwise contrasts for each DGM feature
run_pairwise_contrasts <- function(df, group_var, dgm_columns, output_file) {
  results_list <- list()
  
  for (feature in dgm_columns) {
    formula_str <- as.formula(paste0(feature, " ~ ", group_var, " + (1 | case)"))
    model <- lmer(formula_str, data = df)
    
    emm <- emmeans(model, as.formula(paste0("~ ", group_var)))
    pairwise_contrasts <- contrast(emm, method = "pairwise", adjust = "fdr")
    
    contrast_df <- as.data.frame(pairwise_contrasts)
    contrast_df$program <- feature
    results_list[[feature]] <- contrast_df
  }
  
  combined_df <- bind_rows(results_list)
  write.csv(combined_df, file = output_file, row.names = FALSE)
  return(combined_df)
}

# Run for histopathology
histo_pairwise_dgm <- run_pairwise_contrasts(
  df = sub_mergedDF,
  group_var = "histopathology_comb",
  dgm_columns = dgm_columns,
  output_file = "Histo_pairwise_dgm_contrasts.csv"
)

# Run for immune group
immune_pairwise_dgm <- run_pairwise_contrasts(
  df = sub_immuneDF,
  group_var = "Immune_TV_clean",
  dgm_columns = dgm_columns,
  output_file = "Invasive_immune_pairwise_dgm_contrasts.csv"
)
```

```{r}
# Define text size
text_size = 16

# Define custom shapes for histopathology categories
histopathology_shapes <- c("MIS" = 21, "N" = 22, "P" = 23, "RGP" = 24, "VGP" = 25, "VGP_superficial" = 25)

# Normalize selected pathways to [0, 1]
for (pathway in selected_pathways) {
  colname <- paste0(pathway, "_scaled")
  new_mergedDF[[colname]] <- (
    new_mergedDF[[pathway]] - min(new_mergedDF[[pathway]], na.rm = TRUE)
  ) / (
    max(new_mergedDF[[pathway]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(new_mergedDF[[pathway]], na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

# Initialize list to collect plots
all_exp_plots <- list()

# Loop to generate and store individual plots
for (pathway in selected_pathways) {
  print(pathway)
  colname <- paste0(pathway, "_scaled")
  
  p <- ggplot(new_mergedDF, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, fill = .data[[colname]], shape = histopathology_comb)) +
    geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 1, color = "black") +
    labs(x = paste0("PC1: ", percentVar_non[1], "% variance"),
         y = paste0("PC2: ", percentVar_non[2], "% variance"),
         title = pathway) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      text = element_text(size = text_size),
      axis.text = element_text(size = text_size)
    ) +
    scale_x_reverse() +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "navy", mid = "white", high = "brown", midpoint = 0.5) + 
    scale_shape_manual(values = histopathology_shapes)

  # Save individual plot
  pdf_filename <- paste0("PCA_", pathway, "_scaled.pdf")
  ggsave(pdf_filename, p, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
  message("Saved: ", pdf_filename)
  
  all_exp_plots[[pathway]] <- p
}
```

```{r, fig.height = 8, fig.width= 6}
waterfall_plot <- function(fgsea_results, graph_title) {
  fgsea_results %>%
    dplyr::filter(padj < 0.05) %>%
    arrange(NES) %>%
    mutate(pathway = factor(pathway, levels = pathway)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = pathway, y = NES, fill = NES > 0)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", size = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "tomato", "FALSE" = "steelblue")) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      x = "Pathway",
      y = "Normalized Enrichment Score (NES)",
      title = graph_title
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
    )
}
```

```{r, fig.height= 10, fig.width= 10}
# Create ranked list
rank_res <- as.data.frame(res[order(res$log2FoldChange, decreasing=TRUE ), ])

rank_list["Gene.name"] <- rownames(rank_list)

rank_list <- rank_list[c("Gene.name", "log2FoldChange")]

# formats the ranked list for the fgsea() function
prepare_ranked_list <- function(ranked_list) { 
  # if duplicate gene names present, average the values
  if( sum(duplicated(ranked_list$Gene.name)) > 0) {
    ranked_list <- aggregate(.~Gene.name, FUN = mean, data = ranked_list)
    ranked_list <- ranked_list[order(ranked_list$log2FoldChange, decreasing = T),]
  }
  # omit rows with NA values
  ranked_list <- na.omit(ranked_list)
  # turn the dataframe into a named vector
  ranked_list <- tibble::deframe(ranked_list)
  ranked_list
}

ranked_list <- prepare_ranked_list(rank_list)

# Run fgsea
fgsea_results <- fgsea(pathways = hallmark_pathway_geneSigList,
                       stats = ranked_list,
                       minSize = 15,
                       maxSize = 500,
                       nperm = 1000)

fgsea_results %>% arrange (desc(NES)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(pathway, padj, NES) %>% head()

waterfall_plot <- function(fgsea_results, graph_title) {
    fgsea_results %>%
        # Filter for significant pathways
        dplyr::filter(padj < 0.05) %>%
        # Create the plot
        ggplot(aes(reorder(pathway, NES), NES)) +
        geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue", color = "black", size = 0.3) +  # Black edge added
        coord_flip() +
        labs(x = "Pathway", y = "Normalized Enrichment Score", title = graph_title) +
        theme(
            axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
            plot.title = element_text(hjust = 1)
        ) +
        theme_bw()
}
```

```{r, fig.height = 15, fig.width= 15}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(seriation)
library(grid)

# Step 1: Extract hallmark matrix
heatmap_matrix <- t(merged_gsvaDF[, subset_hallmark])
# Step 2: Apply Optimal Leaf Ordering (OLO)

# Columns (samples)
col_dist <- dist(t(heatmap_matrix), method = "euclidean")
col_ser <- seriate(col_dist, method = "OLO")
col_order <- rev(get_order(col_ser))  # Reverse to show strong responders on left

# Rows (hallmark pathways)
row_dist <- dist(heatmap_matrix, method = "euclidean")
row_ser <- seriate(row_dist, method = "OLO")
row_order <- get_order(row_ser)

# Step 3: Reorder matrix
reordered_matrix <- heatmap_matrix[row_order, col_order]

# Step 4: Scale rows (like pheatmap's scale = "row")
scaled_matrix <- t(scale(t(reordered_matrix)))

# Step 5: Clip to [-2, 2] for consistent color scale
scaled_matrix[scaled_matrix > 2] <- 2
scaled_matrix[scaled_matrix < -2] <- -2

# Step 6: Define color mapping to match pheatmap
pheatmap_colors <- colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")))(101)
breaks_list <- seq(-2, 2, length.out = 101)
col_fun <- colorRamp2(breaks = breaks_list, colors = pheatmap_colors)

# Step 7: Cluster columns to define 3 "trunks"
col_dend <- hclust(dist(t(reordered_matrix)), method = "ward.D2")
col_clusters <- cutree(col_dend, k = 3)[col_order]  # cluster assignment by OLO order

group1 <- c(
  "LSP13145_009", "LSP13145_042", "LSP13135_026", "LSP13165_017", "LSP13140_001", "LSP13145_059", "LSP13985_001", "LSP13985_003", "LSP13140_041", "LSP13140_027", "LSP13170_004", "LSP13140_038", "LSP13140_043",
  "LSP13165_020"
)
group2 <- c("LSP13947_005", "LSP13150_025", "LSP13985_015", "LSP13170_002", "LSP13150_027", "LSP13150_026", "LSP13165_039", "LSP13165_006", "LSP13170_003", "LSP13170_009", "LSP13165_032", "LSP13987_001", "LSP13150_018", "LSP13170_005")

all_samples <- colnames(scaled_matrix)

# 2. Assign group labels
column_groups <- ifelse(all_samples %in% group1, "Group 1",
                  ifelse(all_samples %in% group2, "Group 2", "Group 3"))


# generate new column 
merged_gsvaDF$inflammation_score <- "Low"
merged_gsvaDF[rownames(merged_gsvaDF) %in% group1, "inflammation_score"] <- "High"
merged_gsvaDF[rownames(merged_gsvaDF) %in% group2, "inflammation_score"] <- "Intermediate"

# Step 8: Create top annotations
annotation_df <- merged_gsvaDF[colnames(scaled_matrix), c("histopathology", "case", "comparison", "inflammation_score")]

# Define color map
inflammation_colors <- c(
  "High" = "tomato",
  "Intermediate" = "goldenrod1",
  "Low" = "skyblue"
)

# New annotation for inflammation score
inflammation_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Inflammation = inflammation_score,
  col = list(Inflammation = inflammation_colors),
  annotation_name_side = "left",
  gp = gpar(col = "grey", lwd = 0.5)
)

# 3. Convert to factor to preserve order
column_groups <- factor(column_groups, levels = c("Group 1", "Group 2", "Group 3"))

top_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  df = annotation_df,
  col = list(
    comparison = c("high_entropy" = "tomato", "low_entropy" = "steelblue"),
    case = mel_colors,
    histopathology = hist_colors,
    inflammation_score = inflammation_colors
  ),
  gp = gpar(col = "grey", lwd = 0.5),  # 🔲 Grey border around annotation cells
  annotation_name_side = "left"
)

pdf("manual_column_split_heatmap.pdf", width = 12, height = 10)  # adjust size as needed


ht <- Heatmap(
  scaled_matrix,
  name = "z-score",
  top_annotation = top_ha,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,                      # Now clustering enabled
  column_order = desired_col_order, 
   column_split = column_groups,   # Still preserves your order unless clustering overrides
  # column_split = factor(col_clusters, levels = c(1, 2, 3)),  # Optional
  cluster_column_slices = FALSE,
  show_column_dend = TRUE,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  row_order = rownames(scaled_matrix),
  col = col_fun,
  show_column_names = F,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  column_title = NULL,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "Scaled\nExpression",
    at = c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2),
    labels = c("-2", "-1", "0", "1", "2")
  ),
  border = TRUE,
  width = unit(10, "cm"),
  height = unit(4, "cm"),
  
  # ✅ Fixed cell_fun block
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    grid.rect(x = x, y = y, width = width, height = height, 
              gp = gpar(col = "grey", fill = NA, lwd = 0.5))
  }
)

draw(ht, heatmap_legend_side = "bottom", annotation_legend_side = "bottom")


dev.off()  # Close the PDF device
```

```{r set1 colored, fig.height= 8, fig.width= 10}
library(ggrepel)

text_size <- 16  # fixed typo from 'ext_size'

# Define cases to label
cases_to_label <- c("MEL18", "MEL25", "MEL14", "MEL53")

# Set text size
text_size <- 16

# Output directory (optional: update if needed)
output_dir <- "."

for (case_id in cases_to_label) {
  
  # Subset samples for labeling
  label_df <- subset(stage1_pca_pheno, case == case_id & histopathology %in% c("RGP", "VGP"))
  
  # Create PCA plot
  p <- ggplot(stage1_pca_pheno, aes(PC1, PC2, fill = histopathology)) +
    geom_point(shape = 21, size = 4, alpha = 0.7, color = "black") +
    labs(
      x = "PC1: 33% variance",
      y = "PC2: 10% variance",
      title = paste("PCA Plot colored by", case_id)
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      text = element_text(size = text_size),
      axis.text = element_text(size = text_size),
      axis.line = element_line(size = 0.5, color = "black"),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_blank()
    ) +
    scale_y_reverse() +
    scale_x_reverse() +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = label_df,
      aes(label = MEL_ROI),
      size = 5,
      color = "black",
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      box.padding = 0.6,
      point.padding = 0.8,
      min.segment.length = 0,
      segment.color = "gray40"
    )
  
  # Save each plot as an individual PDF
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0("PCA_", case_id, ".pdf")),
    plot = p,
    width = 10,
    height = 8,
    device = cairo_pdf  # Ensures high-quality text rendering
  )
}
```

```{r}
library(ggpubr)

# Define base text size
base_font_size <- 14
box_width = 0.5

library(scales)  # for label_number

output_dir <- "SOM_spot_branch_comparison_plots"
custom_colors <- c("branch1" = "tomato", "branch3" = "skyblue")  # adjust if needed

# Make output directory
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) dir.create(output_dir)

# Define the comparison
comparisons <- list(c("branch1", "branch3"))

# Columns to plot (A to Q)
plot_cols <- setdiff(colnames(b2_spots_gsvaDF), "sample_label")

# Plot AOInucleiCount
# Loop through each column
for (colname in plot_cols) {
  p <- ggplot(sub2_merged_spotsDF, aes_string(x = "branch", y = colname, fill = "branch")) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = box_width) +
    geom_jitter(color = "grey", size = 2, alpha = 0.8, width = 0.15) +
    stat_compare_means(
      comparisons = comparisons,
      method = "wilcox.test",
      label = "p.signif",
      size = 4
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Comparison of ", colname, " by Branch"),
      x = "Branch",
      y = colname
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = base_font_size) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text = element_text(size = base_font_size),
      axis.title = element_text(size = base_font_size + 1),
      plot.title = element_text(size = base_font_size + 2, hjust = 0.5)
    )

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0("boxplot_", colname, ".pdf")),
    plot = p,
    width = 4,
    height = 5.5
  )
}
```

```{r}
output_dir <- "scaled_spot_plots"

# Create the folder if it doesn't exist
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  dir.create(output_dir)
}

# Initialize list to collect plots
all_spot_plots <- list()

text_size <- 14

# Loop to rescale, plot, and collect
for (spot in plot_cols) {
  
  # Rescale to [0, 1]
  b2_merged_spotsDF[[paste0(spot, "_scaled")]] <- (
    b2_merged_spotsDF[[spot]] - min(b2_merged_spotsDF[[spot]], na.rm = TRUE)
  ) / (
    max(b2_merged_spotsDF[[spot]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(b2_merged_spotsDF[[spot]], na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  scaled_col <- paste0(spot, "_scaled")
  if (all(is.na(b2_merged_spotsDF[[scaled_col]]))) {
    message("Skipped ", spot, " — all NA after scaling.")
    next
    }
  
  # Plot using the scaled values
  p <- ggplot(b2_merged_spotsDF, aes(x = spanning_tree_x, y = spanning_tree_y, fill = .data[[paste0(spot, "_scaled")]])) +
    geom_point(shape = 21, size = 5, alpha = 1, color = "black"
               ) +
    labs(
      x = paste0("X coordinates"),
      y = paste0("Y coordinates"),
      title = spot
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      text = element_text(size = text_size),
      axis.text = element_text(size = text_size)
    ) +
    #scale_x_reverse() +
    #scale_y_reverse() +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "navy", mid = "white", high = "brown", midpoint = 0.5)
  
  
   # Save high-resolution PDF
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0("SOM_", spot, "_scaled_spanning_tree.pdf")),
    plot = p,
    device = "pdf",
    width = 8, height = 8, dpi = 600, useDingbats = FALSE
  )
  
  # Optionally store in list
  all_spot_plots[[spot]] <- p
}
```

```{r}
    aes(x = PC1, y = PC2), fill = "grey", shape = 21, size = 4, alpha = 1, color = "black"
  ) +
  # All other regions — white
  geom_point(
    data = merged_df[merged_df$fill_group == "other", ],
    aes(x = PC1, y = PC2), fill = "yellow", shape = 21, size = 4, alpha = 1, color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "navy", mid = "white", high = "brown",
    midpoint = 0.5,
    limits = c(0, 1),
    name = "Rescaled Depth"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "PC1: 33% variance",
    y = "PC2: 11% variance",
    title = "Depth from DEJ (RGP/VGP only) rescaled"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    #legend.position = "right",
    legend.position = "none",
    text = element_text(size = text_size),
    axis.text = element_text(size = text_size)
  ) +
  scale_x_reverse() #+
  # scale_y_reverse()

# Save
ggsave(
  #filename = "PC1_PC2_RescaledDepth_RGPVGP_only.pdf",
  filename = "PC1_PC2_RescaledDepth_RGPVGP_only_nolabel.pdf",
  plot = p,
  device = "pdf",
  width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 600, useDingbats = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
selected_genes <- c("NGFR", "MLANA", "MITF", "PMEL")

sub_mergedDF <- Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x, y, by = "SampleID", all = TRUE), 
                   list(pcaData_nonbatchcorrect, selected_geneDF))



# Restore row names and remove SampleID column if needed
rownames(sub_mergedDF) <- sub_mergedDF$SampleID

sub_mergedDF <- sub_mergedDF[sub_mergedDF$histopathology_comb!= "accrine gland", ]

sub_mergedDF
```

```{r, fig.height = 8, fig.width= 10}
# Initialize list to collect plots
all_gene_plots <- list()

# Loop to rescale, plot, and collect
for (gene in selected_genes) {
  
  # Rescale to [0, 1]
  sub_mergedDF[[paste0(gene, "_scaled")]] <- (
    sub_mergedDF[[gene]] - min(sub_mergedDF[[gene]], na.rm = TRUE)
  ) / (
    max(sub_mergedDF[[gene]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(sub_mergedDF[[gene]], na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  scaled_col <- paste0(gene, "_scaled")
  if (all(is.na(sub_mergedDF[[scaled_col]]))) {
    message("Skipped ", gene, " — all NA after scaling.")
    next
    }
  
  # Plot using the scaled values
  p <- ggplot(sub_mergedDF, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, fill = .data[[paste0(gene, "_scaled")]])) +
    geom_point(shape = 21, size = 4, alpha = 1, color = "black"
               ) +
    labs(
      x = paste0("PC1: ", round(attr(pcaData_nonbatchcorrect, "percentVar")[1] * 100, 2), "% variance"),
      y = paste0("PC2: ", round(attr(pcaData_nonbatchcorrect, "percentVar")[2] * 100, 2), "% variance"),
      title = gene
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      text = element_text(size = text_size),
      axis.text = element_text(size = text_size)
    ) +
    scale_x_reverse() +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "navy", mid = "white", high = "brown", midpoint = 0.5)
  
  
   # Save high-resolution PDF
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0("PC1_PC2_", gene, "_scaled.pdf"),
    plot = p,
    device = "pdf",
    width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 600, useDingbats = FALSE
  )
  
  # Optionally store in list
  all_gene_plots[[gene]] <- p
}
```

pcaplot by slide with label
```{r}
# Create output folder
output_dir <- "PCA_By_Slide"
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  dir.create(output_dir)
}

# Your full ROI vector (e.g., "LSP13947_7")
slide_roi_vector <- unique(pcaData_nonbatchcorrect_new$slide_roi)

# Get all unique slides from your data
all_slides <- unique(pcaData_nonbatchcorrect_new$slide.name)

for (current_slide in all_slides) {
  message("Processing slide: ", current_slide)
  
  plot_df <- pcaData_nonbatchcorrect_new %>%
    mutate(
      # Highlight in red if the slide matches
      highlight = ifelse(slide.name == current_slide, "highlight", "background"),
      
      # Show text label only if this case is in slide_roi AND belongs to the current slide
      label_text = ifelse(slide_roi %in% slide_roi_vector & slide.name == current_slide, slide_roi, NA)
    )

  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)) +
    geom_point(
      aes(fill = highlight),
      shape = 21, size = 3, alpha = 0.85, color = "black"
    ) +
    geom_text_repel(
      aes(label = label_text),
      size = 2.5,
      max.overlaps = 100,
      box.padding = 0.3,
      segment.color = "grey50",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("highlight" = "red", "background" = "white"),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    labs(
      x = paste0("PC1: ", percentVar_non[1], "% variance"),
      y = paste0("PC2: ", percentVar_non[2], "% variance"),
      title = paste0("Slide: ", current_slide)
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.line = element_line(size = 0.5, color = "black"),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_blank()
    ) +
    scale_x_reverse()

  # Save plot to PDF
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0("PCA_", current_slide, ".pdf")),
    plot = p,
    width = 10, height = 8
  )
}
```

now pathway analysis
```{r}
library(msigdbr)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
```

```{r, convert the hallmark gene to TERM2GENE}
# Load Hallmark pathways using msigdbr
hallmark <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "H")
# Create a mapping table from gene symbol to Entrez ID
symbol_to_entrez <- bitr(unique(hallmark$gene_symbol), fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)
# Remove NA values from conversion
symbol_to_entrez <- symbol_to_entrez[!is.na(symbol_to_entrez$ENTREZID), ]
# Merge with Hallmark data to replace gene symbols with Entrez IDs
hallmark_entrez <- merge(
  hallmark,
  symbol_to_entrez,
  by.x = "gene_symbol",
  by.y = "SYMBOL"
)

# Recreate the pathways list with Entrez IDs
hallmark_pathways_entrez <- split(hallmark_entrez$ENTREZID, hallmark_entrez$gs_name)
TERM2GENE_hallmark <- hallmark_entrez[, c("gs_name", "ENTREZID")]
colnames(TERM2GENE_hallmark) <- c("TERM", "GENE")
```
```{r, convert tumor_states gene to TERM2GENE}
library(KEGGREST)


# Convert custom signatures list to TERM2GENE format
custom_signatures <- selected_geneSig

TERM2GENE_custom <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(custom_signatures), function(term) {
  genes <- custom_signatures[[term]]
  if (length(genes) > 0) {
    data.frame(TERM = term, GENE = genes, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }
}))


# Convert gene symbols to Entrez IDs for the TERM2GENE data frame
symbol_to_entrez <- bitr(unique(TERM2GENE_custom$GENE), fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)

# Remove NA values
symbol_to_entrez <- symbol_to_entrez[!is.na(symbol_to_entrez$ENTREZID), ]

# Merge with TERM2GENE
TERM2GENE_custom <- merge(
  TERM2GENE_custom,
  symbol_to_entrez,
  by.x = "GENE",
  by.y = "SYMBOL"
)

# Retain only the TERM and ENTREZID columns
TERM2GENE_custom <- TERM2GENE_custom[, c("TERM", "ENTREZID")]
```

```{r, fig.height= 8, fig.width= 8}
))

axis(2, at = seq(0, 1, length.out = 5), labels = rev(seq(1, 30, length.out = 5)))
```

now perform trajectory analysis
```{r}
library(slingshot)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
```

```{r}
pca_matrix <-  sub_pcaData_nonbatchcorrect[, c("PC1", "PC2", "histopathology_comb")]
pca_matrix$sample <- rownames(pca_matrix)

sub_merged_tumor_log <- merged_tumor_log[, rownames(sub_pcaData_nonbatchcorrect)]

PCA_sce <- SingleCellExperiment(assays = list(counts = sub_merged_tumor_log))

reducedDims(PCA_sce) <- SimpleList(PCA = as.matrix(pca_matrix[, c("PC1", "PC2")]))

clusters <- kmeans(pca_matrix[, c("PC1", "PC2")], centers = 3)$cluster

pca_matrix$cluster <- as.factor(clusters)

colData(PCA_sce)$cluster <- pca_matrix$cluster

PCA_sce <- slingshot(PCA_sce, 
                     #clusterLabels = 'cluster', 
                     reducedDim = 'PCA')

plot(reducedDims(PCA_sce)$PCA, 
     #col = plotcol, 
     pch=16, asp = 1)

lines(SlingshotDataSet(PCA_sce), lwd=2, col='black')
```

```{r, fig.height = 8, fig.width= 12}
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 4, alpha = 0.8, color = "black") +
  labs(x = paste0("PC1: ", round(attr(sub_pcaData_nonbatchcorrect, "percentVar")[1] * 100, 2), "% variance"),
       y = paste0("PC2: ", round(attr(sub_pcaData_nonbatchcorrect, "percentVar")[2] * 100, 2), "% variance"),
       title = "PCA Plot colored by histopathology") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = hist_colors) + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        text = element_text(size = text_size),
        axis.text = element_text(size = text_size),
        axis.line = element_line(size = 0.5, color = "black"),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank())

# Add trajectory curves
for (curve in curve_data) {
  curve_df <- as.data.frame(curve$s)
  colnames(curve_df) <- c("PC1", "PC2")  # Rename columns for compatibility
  
  merged_hist <- merged_hist +
    geom_path(data = curve_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2), inherit.aes = FALSE, 
              color = 'black', linewidth = 1)  # Use `inherit.aes = FALSE`
}

merged_hist <- merged_hist + scale_x_reverse()

# Display the plot
print(merged_hist)

ggsave("mergedPCA_plot_colored_by_hist_slingshot_nolabel_05082025.pdf",plot = merged_hist,device = "pdf",
       width = 10, height = 8,  # Specify dimensions in inches
       dpi = 300)  # High resolution
```

```{r}
# Define a function to replace only the first three dots with hyphens
replace_first_three_dots <- function(name) {
  # Split the name by dots
  parts <- unlist(strsplit(name, "\\."))
  new_name <- paste(paste(parts[1:4], collapse = "-"), paste(parts[5:length(parts)], collapse = "."), sep = ".")
  return(new_name)
  }

colnames(pca1_norm_batchcorrected) <- sapply(colnames(pca1_norm_batchcorrected), replace_first_three_dots)
```

```{r}
# Split plots into groups of 12

plot_chunks <- split(all_exp_plots, ceiling(seq_along(all_exp_plots) / chunk_size))

for (i in seq_along(plot_chunks)) {
  chunk <- plot_chunks[[i]]
  
  # Skip if chunk is empty or invalid
  if (length(chunk) == 0) next
  
  wrap_plot <- wrap_plots(chunk, ncol = 3, nrow = 4)
  
  pdf_filename <- paste0("PCA_stem", i, ".pdf")
  ggsave(pdf_filename, wrap_plot, width = 20, height = 20, dpi = 300)
  
  message("Saved: ", pdf_filename)
}
```

```{r}
# Initialize list to collect plots
all_signature_plots <- list()

signature_columns <- colnames(mergedDF)[1:which(colnames(mergedDF) == "Landsberg_dedifferentiation_up")]


# Loop to rescale, plot, and save
for (pathway in signature_columns) {
  
  # Rescale the pathway values to [0, 1]
  mergedDF[[paste0(pathway, "_scaled")]] <- (
    mergedDF[[pathway]] - min(mergedDF[[pathway]], na.rm = TRUE)
  ) / (
    max(mergedDF[[pathway]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(mergedDF[[pathway]], na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  
  # Create the plot using the scaled column
  p <- ggplot(mergedDF, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, fill = .data[[paste0(pathway, "_scaled")]], shape = histopathology_comb)) +
    geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 1, color = "black") +
    labs(
      x = paste0("PC1: ", round(attr(sub_pcaData_nonbatchcorrect, "percentVar")[1] * 100, 2), "% variance"),
      y = paste0("PC2: ", round(attr(sub_pcaData_nonbatchcorrect, "percentVar")[2] * 100, 2), "% variance")
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      text = element_text(size = text_size),
      axis.text = element_text(size = text_size)
    ) +
    scale_x_reverse() +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "navy", mid = "white", high = "brown", midpoint = 0.5
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = histopathology_shapes)
  
  all_exp_plots[[pathway]] <- p
  
  # Save plot
  pdf_filename <- paste0("PCA_", pathway, "_Signature_Score_05082025.pdf")

}
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# Define text size
text_size = 16

# Define custom shapes for histopathology categories
histopathology_shapes <- c("MIS" = 21, "N" = 22, "P" = 23, "RGP" = 24, "VGP" = 25, "VGP_superficial" = 25)

# Get all hallmark gene sets (from column 1 to "Landsberg_dedifferentiation_up")
signature_columns <- colnames(mergedDF)[1:which(colnames(mergedDF) == "Landsberg_dedifferentiation_up")]


# Initialize list to collect plots
all_pca_plots <- list()

# Loop to generate and store plots
for (signature in signature_columns) {
  
  p <- ggplot(mergedDF, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, fill = .data[[signature]], shape = histopathology_comb)) +
    geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.8, color = "black") +
    labs(x = paste0("PC1: ", round(attr(pcaData_nonbatchcorrect, "percentVar")[1] * 100, 2), "% variance"),
       y = paste0("PC2: ", round(attr(pcaData_nonbatchcorrect, "percentVar")[2] * 100, 2), "% variance"),
         title = signature) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",  # suppress legends for grid view
      text = element_text(size = text_size),
      axis.text = element_text(size = text_size)
    ) +
    scale_x_reverse() +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "navy", mid = "white", high = "tomato", 
      midpoint = median(mergedDF[[signature]], na.rm = TRUE)
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = histopathology_shapes)
  
  all_pca_plots[[signature]] <- p
}

# Split plots into groups of 12
chunk_size <- 12
plot_chunks <- split(all_pca_plots, ceiling(seq_along(all_pca_plots) / chunk_size))

# Save each chunk as a separate PDF
for (i in seq_along(plot_chunks)) {
  chunk <- plot_chunks[[i]]
  wrap_plot <- wrap_plots(chunk, ncol = 3, nrow = 4)
  
  pdf_filename <- paste0("PCA_Hallmark_Page_", i, ".pdf")
  ggsave(pdf_filename, wrap_plot, width = 20, height = 20, dpi = 300)
  
  message("Saved: ", pdf_filename)
}

```

```{r}
mergedDF_zscore <- mergedDF %>%

# Initialize list to collect plots

for (signature in signature_columns) {

         title = signature) +

      axis.text = element_text(size = text_size)
    ) +
    scale_x_reverse() +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "navy", mid = "white", high = "tomato", 
      midpoint = median(mergedDF[[signature]], na.rm = TRUE)
    ) +

}

# Split plots into groups of 12
chunk_size <- 12
plot_chunks <- split(all_pca_plots, ceiling(seq_along(all_pca_plots) / chunk_size))

# Loop through chunks and save each as separate PDF
for (i in seq_along(plot_chunks)) {
  chunk <- plot_chunks[[i]]
  
  # If this is the last chunk, modify plots to show legends
  if (i == length(plot_chunks)) {
    for (j in seq_along(chunk)) {
      chunk[[j]] <- chunk[[j]] + theme(legend.position = "right")
    }
  }
  
  wrap_plot <- wrap_plots(chunk, ncol = 3, nrow = 4, guides = "collect") & theme(legend.position = "right")
  
  pdf_filename <- paste0("PCA_Signature_Zscore_Page_", i, ".pdf")
  ggsave(pdf_filename, wrap_plot, width = 20, height = 24, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
# condition 1 
matched_dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = round(matched_tumor_raw),
                              colData = matched_colData, 
                              design = ~ histopathology + batch_str)

matched_dds <- DESeq(matched_dds)

matched_dds <- estimateSizeFactors(matched_dds)

matched_norm_counts <- as.data.frame(counts(matched_dds, normalized = T))

# transform the normal counts
matched_lognorm <- log2(matched_norm_counts + 1)

matched_lognorm_matrix <- as.matrix(matched_lognorm)

batch <- matched_colData$Batch_str
condition <- matched_colData$histopathology

library(limma)

# Apply removeBatchEffect
batch_corrected_counts <- removeBatchEffect(matched_lognorm_matrix, batch=batch, design=model.matrix(~condition))

# Result: batch-corrected log-normalized matrix
batch_corrected_counts_matrix <- batch_corrected_counts
```

```{r, fig.height= 6, fig.width = 4}
library(car)  # for leveneTest

custom_colors <- c("branch1" = "tomato", "branch3" = "skyblue")

# Run Levene's test
levene_result <- car::leveneTest(H_spatial ~ branch, data = merged_entropy)
p_val <- formatC(levene_result$`Pr(>F)`[1], format = "e", digits = 2)

# Create plot
p_t <- ggplot(merged_entropy, aes_string(x = "branch", y = "H_spatial", fill = "branch")) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = box_width) +
    geom_jitter(color = "grey", size = 1.5, alpha = 0.8, width = 0.15) +
    stat_compare_means(
      comparisons = comparisons,
      method = "wilcox.test",
      label = "p.signif",
      size = 5  # Increase significance label font size
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Entropy Score by Branch"),
      x = "Branch",
      y = "Entropy_Score"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = base_font_size) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text = element_text(size = base_font_size),
      axis.title = element_text(size = base_font_size + 2),
      plot.title = element_text(size = base_font_size + 4, hjust = 0.5)
    )

p_l <- ggplot(merged_entropy, aes(x = branch, y = H_spatial, fill = branch)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = box_width) +
  geom_jitter(color = "grey", size = 1.5, alpha = 0.8, width = 0.15) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Entropy Score by Branch"),
    subtitle = paste0("Levene's Test p = ", p_val),
    x = "Branch",
    y = "Entropy Score"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = base_font_size) +5
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text = element_text(size = base_font_size),
    axis.title = element_text(size = base_font_size + 2),
    plot.title = element_text(size = base_font_size + 4, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = base_font_size + 2, hjust = 0.5)
  )

# Save Wilcoxon-based plot
ggsave(
  filename = "entropy_wilcoxon_plot.pdf",
  plot = p_t,
  width = 4,
  height = 6,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)

# Save Levene's test plot
ggsave(
  filename = "entropy_levene_plot.pdf",
  plot = p_l,
  width = 4,
  height = 6,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)
```
